review_candidates.title: Senior Infrastructure & Cloud Engineer - Remote
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key responsibilities: - Designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure solutions across multiple platforms. - Leading incident response and troubleshooting for complex infrastructure issues. Requirements: - Infrastructure Experience: 4+ years in infrastructure and cloud engineering roles. - Technical Foundation: Strong understanding of networking, security, and system administration.
eligibility_evidence: If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements: - Infrastructure Experience: 4+ years in infrastructure and cloud engineering roles. - Cloud Expertise: Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and services. - Automation Skills: Proficiency in automation tools and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
